en: Sepia-toned photograph mounted on a light border, showing a dusty open area or square with several two‑storey and single‑storey buildings in the background. An early motor vehicle is driving on the dirt road to the left, while a few people, including children, stand or walk in the foreground. The style of the buildings is typical late‑Ottoman / early 20th‑century eastern Mediterranean. Handwritten Greek script appears at the bottom left, and a printed website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is overlaid on the lower right.
